summary: The Docker image build passed on explicitly free port 3110, but both detached launches exited before /health could respond. Existing services were untouched and cleanup left no temporary container. Reports preserve browser, axe, and visual passes while recording Docker runtime failure and Lighthouse as pending.
deviations: Retried the exact Docker launch once after confirming the first --rm container had exited; no alternate port was needed because 3110 was free.
remaining_blockers: Docker container runtime does not expose /health; the exact exit cause is unavailable because --rm removed the exited container before logs could be collected.
stopped_because: Docker could not run and expose /health; per task stop condition, returned blocked without fabricating success.
